# Home icons

Simple Icons assets are bundled for Netflix, Twitch, Kick, GeForce NOW (NVIDIA), Steam, Wikipedia, Reddit, X, and GitHub. The [Simple Icons project](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) is distributed under CC0. Its [disclaimer](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/DISCLAIMER.md) describes the terms and brand guidelines for individual marks.

The remaining default shortcuts load icons from their sites at runtime. The app caches them locally and uses a text placeholder until a usable icon is available. No downloaded favicon is included in the source or IPA. Names and marks identify the linked sites.
